mismatches.cause: rules.json timing (start not before the action window ends) puts the first send date after this crop's calendar end; the golden formula (no action-window clamp) starts earlier and keeps the survey. Contract disagreement, not a code defect.

rules.json requires a window at least min_width_days wide AND nothing after 31 March; both cannot hold for this insight, so it is held back rather than sent with a truncated window. The golden set accepts the truncated (even zero-width) window. Conservative decision pending Digital Green's ruling.

relevance.method: Jaccard over content words of prompts+labels vs golden item texts+options (proxy only)

notes: Eligibility uses rules.json + the content-based junk signature; the golden labels are never read by the decision code.

Timing is computed with the rules.json formula (which reproduces the pack's worked scenarios). The golden set uses a different formula (09:00 start, no action-window clamp), so date agreement is reported separately from overlap.
Relevance is a lexical proxy (token overlap with the golden item texts), not a judgement of language quality.
